column2: Isiphithiphithi sasemini. Akukho intanethi. Akukho ngxaki.
I-Khaynjo ilawula igumbi lakho lokutyela, ikhitshi nekhawuntara kwizixhobo osele unazo — ukusuka etafileni ukuya ekhitshini ukuya kwibhili, nokuba ikhona i-intanethi okanye akukho.
I-Android kwi-Google Play namhlanje · iinguqulelo ze-Windows ne-Linux ziyeza.
Cofa itafile ukuze uyilandele kutyelelo olunye. Imibala namagama afanayo nala akwi-app — kwaye itafile iba ngenamntu kuphela xa sele ihlawulwe.

Isitya esinye esidumileyo esivela kwilizwe ngalinye — igama lesiNgesi, igama ngombhalo wabo, nesitya ngesiNgesi. Faka loo magama kuluhlu lwakho lokutya. Umhlaba uqhubeka udlula; misa okanye khangela xa ufuna ukujonga.
Fumana ilizwe okanye isitya — umz. India, biryani, Japan
Isitya esinye esidumileyo kwilizwe ngalinye — umngcelele ujikeleza umhlaba wonke.
Itafile enye, ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekugqibeleni.
Jonga itafile isuka xa iindwendwe zihlala phantsi ide ibe Ihlawulwe — amanyathelo nemibala efanayo ebonwa ngabasebenzi bakho kwi-app.
Phawula itafile ngokuthi Ihlaliwe ngoko nangoko xa iindwendwe zihlala. Yongeza izitya, khetha ubungakanani, yongeza izongezo, uze uchwetheze inqaku lekhitshi — kanye etafileni.
Khetha ubungakanani obunye; yongeza izongezo ozikhethelayo ukuya kumda owubekileyo.

Thumela i-odolo kwaye isikhululo ngasinye sifumana izitya zaso kuphela — zinamanani osuku ngalunye, netafile, umphakeli nawo onke amanqaku. Akukho xabiso: ikhitshi liyapheka, ikhawuntara iyahlawulisa.
Thumela, kwaye itikiti lishicilelwa kwisikhululo esifanelekileyo — akukho mntu ulithwalayo.
Ikhitshi libona into ekufuneka iphekwe ngoku

Kwisikrini sekhitshi amatikiti ahamba Entsha → Iyalungiswa → Ilungile ngokucofa kanye. Amatikiti amadala atshintsha umbala abe shushu, “Okuphekwa ngoku” kubala zonke izitya ezilindileyo, kwaye izitya eziphambili zingalinda de kuphume izitya zokuqala.
Hlawulisa nangayiphi na indlela undwendwe oluhlawula ngayo

Imali ephathekayo enetshintshi lokubuyisa, i-UPI enexabiso esele likwi-QR, intlawulo yenxalenye, okanye ityala kwincwadi yamatyala yomthengi. Yahlula ngento, ngesihlalo okanye ngokulinganayo. Itafile iba ngenamntu kuphela xa ibhili yayo sele ihlawulwe.
Ithiphu ibhalwa yodwa — ayizange ixutywe nentengiso.

Bala idrowa yemali uyithelekise nemali yokuqala, imali ephathekayo efunyenweyo, iithiphu nemali ephathekayo ekhutshiweyo — ukusilela okanye ukugqitha kuyachazwa. Shicilela isiliphu seshifti, uze uvule ingxelo yosuku ngabasebenzi, uhlobo lwe-odolo, iyure nesitya, kunye nokurhoxisiweyo, izitya zasimahla neethiphu.
ZONKE EZINYE IZINTO EZIFUNWA LIGUMBI LOKUTYELA
Iinguqu ezenzeka rhoqo emini — ziphathwa ekuhleni, kugcinwa ukuba ngubani, nini kwaye ngoba.
Iindwendwe zitshintsha iitafile — i-odolo nemizuzu yayo ihamba nazo. Iitafile ezimbini, ibhili enye.
Ngesizathu, nokuba sekuphekiwe okanye akunjalo, nokuba ngubani owamkeleyo. Ikhitshi lifumana isiliphu sokurhoxisa.
Isitya sasimahla sihlala kwibhili ku-₹ 0, nesizathu nalowo usamkeleyo.
Isenzo ngasinye siyavunyelwa, sivunyelwa nge-PIN yomphathi, okanye asivunyelwa — umntu ngamnye.
Khangela ngegama okanye ngekhowudi emfutshane, namanye amagama ngolunye ulwimi — “ptk” ifumana i-Paneer tikka.
Ixabiso eliphezulu kwigumbi le-AC; izintlu zokutya kwakusasa namaxabiso eyure yesaphulelo ngokwewotshi.
Iintlawulo zenxalenye netyala zingena kwi-akhawunti yomthengi kwi-Amaqabane, zihlawulwe kamva.
Iintengiso ngabasebenzi, uhlobo lwe-odolo, iyure nesitya — kudweliswe nokurhoxisiweyo, izitya zasimahla neethiphu.
Uluhlu lwakho lokutya, lulungile kwimizuzu embalwa.
Seta ikhawuntara yakho uze ukhethe uluhlu lokutya lokuqala olunemifanekiso — uze utshintshe amagama, amaxabiso neekhowudi zibe zezakho. Simahla ukukhuphela kwi-khaynjo.com.
Ukutya kwehlabathi — kwaseJapan, eMexico, e-Italy, eIndiya, eThailand nokunye — isitya ngasinye nomfanekiso waso.
Iti, ikofu, iziselo ezibandayo, izinto ezibhakiweyo neeshwamshwam — kulungele ikhefi enekhawuntara.
Ishelufu elipheleleyo lemifanekiso yoluntu — khetha umfanekiso wesitya osongezayo.

Ii-odolo, amatikiti ekhitshi, iibhili nencwadi yosuku zihlala kwizixhobo zakho. Xa i-intanethi inqamuka phakathi kwexesha lasemini, akukho nto kwindawo yakho yokutyela eyilindileyo — kwaye akukho akhawunti kuthi ekufuneka ungene kuyo.
Ikhawuntara: ithatha ii-odolo kwaye ihlawulisa iibhili
Incwadi yosuku: zonke iibhili zigcinwe kwesi sixhobo
Iitablethi zeentloko zabaphakeli nesikrini sekhitshi: zisebenza kunye kwi-Wi-Fi yakho
Amandla esoftware asiyiyo into esiyithengisayo. Sebenzisa yonke i-Khaynjo kwizixhobo zakho ngaphandle kwentlawulo — akukho nto itshixiweyo emva kwesicwangciso.
Igumbi lokutyela, ikhitshi, iibhili, ukuvala usuku, iingxelo — i-app epheleleyo.
Akukho ntlawulo ngetafile, umphakeli, i-odolo okanye isixhobo.
Inkonzo yemihla ngemihla ayifuni kubhalisa okanye i-intanethi.

Steady ₹6 000 · Swift ₹12 000 · Priority ₹24 000 / ngonyaka ngaphandle kwerhafu (irhafu xa uhlawula). Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso luqikelelo lwexabiso — lunokuba ngaphantsi kwe-Steady okanye ngaphezu kwe-Priority. I-Khaynjo kwizixhobo zakho ihlala isimahla ngonaphakade nokuba kunjani na.
Hayi. Ii-odolo, ii-KOT, iibhili nencwadi yosuku zisebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Uyayidinga kanye ukuze ukhuphele i-app kwaye, ukuba uyafuna, uluhlu lokutya lokuqala.
Kwisixhobo sakho, kwivenkile yakho — hayi kwiiseva zethu. Yenza iikopi zogcino kwi-Useto uze uzigcine naphi na apho uthanda khona.
Iifowuni neetablethi ze-Android namhlanje, kwi-Google Play. Iinguqulelo ze-Windows ne-Linux zisendleleni.
Ewe — kwiiprinta zobushushu ozisete kwi-Useto → Abashicileli, itikiti lekhitshi elinye kwisikhululo ngasinye.
Ewe. Izikrini zifumaneka ngeelwimi ezili-115, isiArabhu nesiUrdu ukusuka ekunene ukuya ekhohlo, kwaye amagama ezitya anokuba namanye amagama ngomnye umbhalo.

Akukho nto kwizixhobo zakho — zonke iimpawu, ngonaphakade. I-Kumkaj Cloud ozikhethelayo yeyonyaka: Steady / Swift / Priority (okanye uqikelelo lwexabiso olwenziwe ngokwezifiso); vula i-/shop ukuze uthenge.
Simahla kwi-Google Play. Ufuna ukuboniswa kuqala? Sithumelele umyalezo kwi-WhatsApp.
Izifaki ziya kubekwa apha xa nganye iphumelele ukufakwa kumatshini omtsha. Okwangoku, cela umboniso kwi-WhatsApp.
Umgca womboniso we-WhatsApp uza kuvuleka kungekudala. Umyalezo wakho uza kufundeka ngolu hlobo: “{message}”.
Akukho lizwe okanye sitya esihambelana nolo khangelo.
Ukukhangela kumisa umngcelele; kucime ukuze uqhubeke, okanye uhlale umisiwe njengoko uwushiyile.
I-akhawunti enye yesayithi nee-app — ifomu efanayo nokuba umtsha okanye uyabuya.
Siza kukuthumelela ikhonkco lokuseta kwakhona nge-imeyile. Sebenzisa idilesi efanayo obhalise ngayo.
Qhagamshela iindlela kwi-akhawunti enye ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela ukufikelela ukuba enye iyasilela.
Izicwangciso zelifu zonyaka — irhafu yongezwa xa uhlawula. I-app epheleleyo ye-Khaynjo kwizixhobo zakho ihlala isimahla ngonaphakade, ngaphandle kwezibhengezo.
Inqwelo yakho ayinanto. Yongeza i-Steady, i-Swift okanye i-Priority.
Ukuhlawula kukungenisa kwiphepha le-akhawunti, emva koko kuqalise intlawulo (ukulinganisa kovavanyo okanye i-Paddle xa izitshixo zisetiwe).

Izicwangciso zonyaka — isango lokuhlawula longeza irhafu xa uhlawula. Ukusebenzisa kwisixhobo sakho kuhlala kusimahla ngonaphakade. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso luqikelelo lwexabiso (lunokuba ngaphantsi kwe-Steady okanye ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
